title: Shared acceptance-test fixture eliminates per-test setup duplication
essence: A new shared_fixtures.go file consolidates repeated Azure DevOps project/org bootstrap logic used across acceptance tests, reducing boilerplate and ensuring consistent setup. Tests that previously duplicated fixture setup now delegate to the shared helper.

checkpoints.label: main
checkpoints.caption: Quality gate: release and taskagent acceptance test packages pass
checkpoints.beforeNote: Each acceptance test independently set up its own project/org fixture, leading to duplicated setup code across test files.
checkpoints.afterNote: shared_fixtures.go provides a single tested helper; resource_release_definition_test.go delegates to it. The full quality-gate command exits 0.

impact: Eliminates duplicated Azure DevOps project bootstrap code across acceptance tests
Ensures consistent fixture state across all acceptance tests in the release and taskagent packages
Reduces test maintenance burden — fixture changes need only be made in one place

filesChanged.note: New shared fixture helper for acceptance tests
Unit tests for the shared fixture helper
Updated to use shared fixture instead of local setup

acceptanceCriteria: shared_fixtures.go exists and is tested by shared_fixtures_test.go
